identity: Kezamba trades with the spirits at its cenote shrine, and a broker has started trading the offerings instead.

quests.title: The Spirits Left Footprints
quests.text: The cenote receives our prayers, but someone with boots is receiving the offerings. Kill six Toll Bandits in the {name:canopy} {zone_area:canopy} after dark, and mind the Reed-Fang Vipers sharing those paths. We shall see how generous the spirits seem when the thieves stop walking away with their gifts.
quests.lesson: The bandits are the canopy's minor night role.

quests.title: Tusks Between the Prayers
quests.text: Pilgrims have been dropping their offerings and fleeing Jungle Razorbacks on the shrine paths. Hunters are driving the beasts there on somebody's coin; this is no ill omen, just a cruel trick. Kill six Jungle Razorbacks by day in the {name:vinewood} {zone_area:vinewood} so our people can finish a prayer standing still.

quests.title: A Bow Behind Every Bargain
quests.text: Takka is paying the hunters, and Toll Bandit Archers guard the business at the {name:tollcamp} {dir_from_giver:tollcamp}. Kill six archers there. They will keep their distance, so close in or use the trees for cover; a blessing travels with you, but it is no substitute for a trunk.
quests.lesson: Archers keep their distance; close in or use cover.

quests.title: The Price of a Prayer
quests.text: Bandit Offering-Broker Takka waits in the {name:tollcamp} {dir_from_giver:offering_broker_takka}, selling stolen offerings back to the very pilgrims who brought them. Kill Takka and end this trade. Our people should kneel at the water because they choose to pray, never because a thief has emptied their hands twice.

quests.title: Carry the Drumbeat
quests.text: You have given the shrine room to breathe; now the Throng needs that strength beyond our boardwalks. Go to Thunderstep Watch in Thunderroot Wilds and speak with Rumela Stormstep, whose people face the Accord there. Take our drumbeat with you, even when you are too far away to hear it.

quests.title: A Voice for Ashveil
quests.text: The drums call for help beyond our jungle, too. Travel to Ashveil Watch on Blackwind Rise and speak with Vaska Ashlistener; our undead kin hold a front there. Let Vaska hear what Kezamba can offer the Throng.

quests.title: Smoke Cannot Fill a Belly
quests.text: Half of Kezamba follows its nose to my door, and I cannot feed it the smell. Bring me eight Raw Meat from the Reed Tapirs grazing by day in the {name:canopy} {zone_area:canopy}. The smokehouse needs something to smoke before those noses turn into complaints.

quests.title: Keep Supper Hanging
quests.text: My smokehouse racks need new hooks, and I have quite enough to hold without hanging supper from my own tusks. Bring me two Gnarled Boar Tusks from the Jungle Razorbacks in the {name:vinewood} {zone_area:vinewood}. If Nalo has you hunting them by day already, remember that hungry people have prayers too.

quests.title: Bounty: The Smoke Must Rise
quests.text: The fire settles down, a fresh queue forms, and back I go to feeding Kezamba. Kill six Jungle Razorbacks by day in the {name:vinewood} {zone_area:vinewood} for this repeatable bounty. You can take it again twenty minutes after turning it in; the city's appetite has no such pause.

quests.title: Regards from the Smokehouse
quests.text: Taleko Drycord trades me reeds for smoked fish, a sensible friendship with something useful at both ends. Go to Whisperreed Landing in the Whispering Reedlands and give Taleko my regards. Ask what needs doing while you are there; the reeds always seem to be hiding another problem.

quests.title: Even Seers Need Supper
quests.text: Tokai Knotreader can read trouble in the river knots, yet never seems to foresee the last fish leaving the plate. Go to Totemwater Post in Totemwater Reach and speak with Tokai. Say the smokehouse remembers, and ask what the river has been saying lately.
